title: clinical/departments
description: One row per clinical department within one hospital. Departments divide a hospital into clinical specialties. The same department name appears at many hospitals -- 'Cardiology' exists at most of them -- so a department is identified by the pair (hospital_id, name), not by name alone.

hospital_id.description: The hospital this department belongs to. Every department belongs to exactly one site.

name.description: Department name, drawn from a fixed list of twelve clinical specialties so that the same names recur across hospitals and can be grouped.

floor.description: Which floor of the building the department occupies, from 0 (ground) to 8.

phone_extension.description: Internal four-digit extension. Not dialable from outside; this is the number staff would use.
